load_bearing_ideas: Isolation in model_call.py is construction-level: each call's input is built from exactly system_prompt + json.dumps(stage_input), tool-free, one turn, fresh session — no code path exists for transcripts or files to leak in.
Re-asks send the plain-language validation error back with the original input so attempt 2 is a guided repair, bounded at 3 attempts, failing loudly after.
Fresh context per stage means the only inter-stage channel is the small typed baton, which Python validates — enforcement in code, not prompts.
The supervisor (deterministic Python) enforces gate decisions: after gate 1 it shrinks the payload to {domain, chosen_hypothesis} so downstream stages cannot see or second-guess the ranked list.
Payload DATA may name substrate specifics; stage code and supervisor never branch on substrate names found in payloads.

text: Build-Book Step 10 complete: stage 3 real — ONE Opus call on the spike's frozen Step-6 PROMPT_V2 judgment text (freeze re-verified from disk: 2029 identical prefix bytes, diverging exactly at the output-format swap; chunk-1's reported 2015 was terminal line-wrap corruption), JSON verdict {label trust|refine|defer, rationale, right_instrument} enforced in Python; verdict travels as payload.fidelity_verdict and is evidenced at stage3/verdict.json. Five-spec eyeball run came back 5/5 defer, all attempts=1 — an observation, NOT a scored result: no answer keys exist. Strategy-chat structural reading: defer-heavy is the expected equilibrium while run_cfd exposes no physical QoI — every honest spec needs a quantity the instrument cannot return, so the trust/refine boundary only opens at Step 11 when the wrapper extracts QoIs. Proven under the supervisor: auto run 20260704T033305Z (h4 at rank 1, defer on the missing spanwise dimension; stage-2 RE-ASK fired live for the first time, recovered on attempt 2) and human demo 20260704T034650Z (rank 2 of 4 chosen, defer on missing scalar-field extraction) — two different, spec-specific defer rationales, not a rubber stamp. Gate 5 currently shows the verdict only buried in the full baton JSON dump; surfacing it is a pending strategy-chat decision.

load_bearing_ideas: Q: Why is 5/5 defer not a failure of the fidelity gate? A: Both verified rationales correctly name their spec's real blocker (no spanwise coordinate; no scalar-field extraction). The instrument genuinely cannot answer today's specs, so defer is the truthful verdict — and it is an observation, not a scored result, because no answer keys exist.

Q: When does the trust/refine boundary open? A: At Step 11, when run_cfd graduates in and the wrapper starts extracting physical QoIs. Until the instrument can return a quantity a spec actually needs, defer is the structural equilibrium.

Q: What exactly is frozen in stage 3? A: The spike's PROMPT_V2 judgment text — zones, the v2 trust-vs-refine paragraph, the judge-only-from-given guard — byte-identical for 2029 prefix bytes; only the output-format tail was swapped for the JSON envelope, which Python (extra_validator) enforces.

Q: What does the fidelity verdict deliberately NOT cover? A: Axis 3 — whether the regime assumption that places a case in-envelope is itself certain. No axis-3 language was added; pretending otherwise is forbidden until it is actually handled.
Q: Who authors stage 3's history entry? A: Code, not the model — label plus a rationale excerpt. The model's only channel is the validated JSON verdict; the baton stays typed and small.

Q: Does the human see the verdict at gate 5? A: Only buried inside the full baton JSON dump that run_gate prints in human mode. Whether to surface it is a strategy-chat decision, deliberately not made this chunk.

text: Build-Book Step 11 complete: the spike's run_cfd wrapper graduated into production (tools/run_cfd.py, deterministic Python, NO AI) — its own container of12-prod (from image of12-img, a fresh docker commit of of12) with ~/research-system/cases bind-mounted at /work/cases; every proven behavior survived (case's controlDict declares solver/endTime/deltaT, docker exec with the OpenFOAM bashrc sourced, log.<application> in the case dir, 600 s timeout, small parsed summary with the exact converged definition, full log NEVER returned). One new capability, minimal tier: OPTIONAL single-QoI extraction — operations volAverage | min | max | volIntegrate on a field the case already wrote, optional component (mag or 0|1|2), latest time only, via OpenFOAM's own stock postProcess volFieldValue machinery; summary gains qoi {name, field, operation, value, time} on success, qoi_error and NO number on any failure — the instrument never fabricates. Live proof on cases/cavity_baseline: converged=true; volAverage(mag(U)) = 0.4168179 m/s at t=20, physically plausible (0 < 0.417 < lid 2 m/s) and EXACTLY reproduced on an identical repeat (determinism); honest refusal on a nonexistent field c. CAVITY_2D_CONTRACT truth-edited to match: velocity/pressure-field statistics YES, concentration/tracer fields NO (no scalar-transport physics), no new fields, no time-series, one QoI per run; unconverged-run QoIs reported without endorsement. Five-spec re-run through the unchanged fidelity gate (same specs, same gate code, same frozen prompt — the ONLY moved variable was the contract): 5/5 defer again, no label moved; NOT scored (no answer keys; rationales are the evidence). The rationales now cite the contract's new precise boundary — no scalar-transport physics / no concentration field (three specs), single-shot no-time-series (one of them), and the Re~200 envelope (two) — where Step 10's defers cited the blanket 'no field extraction at all'. Human demo 20260704T063051Z: rank 2 of 4 chosen (h4, S-shaped sidewall undulation), valid spec, verdict defer ('2D momentum-only, writes no concentration field, cannot represent the inherently 3D S-shaped undulation nor extract the scalar-based Danckwerts mixing index'), gates 2/5 y, and the new gate-5 FIDELITY VERDICT display block was seen by the builder and is durable in log.txt.

load_bearing_ideas: Q: What can the instrument actually measure now? A: One quantity per run, computed from fields the run already wrote (velocity/pressure statistics: volAverage/min/max/volIntegrate, optional component), at the latest time only. Nothing the case didn't write, no time-series, no concentration fields.

Q: Why is the honest-refusal property load-bearing? A: The QoI path is the first place a stage-facing number is manufactured from raw solver output; qoi_error-with-no-number on any failure is what keeps a fabricated value from ever entering a baton.

Q: Why did all five verdicts stay defer after the contract opened QoIs? A: The five specs genuinely need what is still impossible — tracer/mixing physics, time-series, far-out-of-envelope Re — so the truthful label did not move; what moved is the rationale, which now names the precise new boundary instead of a blanket no-extraction.

Q: What made the re-run a fair one-variable experiment? A: Same five specs from disk, same gate code, same frozen PROMPT_V2, same model; only substrates.py's contract text changed between Step 10's run and this one.

Q: What does an unconverged run's QoI mean? A: The wrapper reports it without endorsement (convergence is a separate field); deciding whether such a value is usable is downstream judgment, deliberately not the wrapper's.
Q: What still is NOT handled? A: Axis 3 (regime-assumption certainty) remains uncovered by the fidelity check; the wrapper is hand-driven only — no stage calls it until Step 12 wires stage 4.

Q: Where does the trust/refine boundary stand? A: Still untested by these five specs — none of them fit the instrument even now; a spec asking for an in-envelope velocity/pressure QoI is what would finally exercise trust/refine.

text: Build-Book Step 12 complete: stage 4 is real — a deterministic, verdict-gated simulation runner (ZERO model calls) behind the frozen run(baton)->baton interface; the Haiku ack stub is retired (stages 5-6 remain stubs). Chunk 1 witnessed all three paths through the side door: (a) EXECUTED handfeed4-20260704T083221Z — 2 real solver runs, both converged, run 1 volAverage(mag(U)) = 0.4168353 at t=20, run 2 = 0.1930067 (lid 1.0 vs 2.0 — lower as expected, sub-linear because Re halves to 100); (b) SKIPPED handfeed4-20260704T083312Z — execution_results exactly {status: skipped_defer}, zero case dirs; (c) HALTED handfeed4-20260704T083329Z — halted_synthesis at run 1 of 3 naming all eight unsupported parameters, zero solver invocations, honest qoi_translation_error for the free-text QoI. Discretization pair for the record: 0.4168179 @ deltaT=0.002 (Step-11 baseline) vs 0.4168353 @ deltaT=0.005 (chunk-1 executed proof) — 4-significant-figure agreement between two different discretizations of the same case; the chunk-1 record calling this a 'mismatch' was a strategy-chat dictation error, resolved. Chunk 2 put stage 4 under the supervisor in both modes, verdict-gated for real: auto run 20260704T084910Z (defer verdict on the h4 Peclet-reduction spec -> skipped_defer branch: stage-4 elapsed <1 ms, zero case dirs, honest results.json) and human demo 20260704T090024Z (rank 2 of 4 chosen at gate 1 (h2), valid spec, defer verdict — no scalar-transport physics + 3D Hopf instability at Re_c~1914 — -> skipped_defer branch; builder saw the boxed FIDELITY VERDICT plus the new EXECUTION line at gate 5). The executed and halted branches have run only via the side door so far — under the supervisor both live runs drew defer, consistent with the standing observation that model-authored specs defer until stage 2 learns the contract's machine-readable QoI keys. That is the NAMED Step-13 opening change (stage 2 learns qoi {field, operation, component?}); it is also a Step-15 schema candidate (validate_spec could then require the machine keys). Opening tidy: cases/cavity_baseline pruned back to a clean template {0/, constant/ (incl. polyMesh), system/} at a recorded checkpoint (Step-11 proof artifacts deleted, disclosed file-by-file; template != evidence store) and its controlDict header truth-edited from the spike-era '(answer key)' to 'Production template, graduated from the Step-5 spike case.' Gate-5 header extension (ratified JC6d, display-only): build_gate5_header now appends an EXECUTION section when payload.execution_results exists — status, then per-run one-liners (run N: converged true/false, qoi <value> | qoi_error <msg>) for executed, 'nothing executed: defer verdict' for skipped_defer, 'reason: <halt reason>' otherwise; pure never-raise, 5 new unit tests, 52/52 total.

load_bearing_ideas: Q: What decides whether stage 4 runs anything? A: Stage 3's verdict label alone — defer skips (nothing built, nothing executed), trust/refine executes; the gate is enforced in deterministic Python, not by a prompt.

Q: Why did both supervised runs skip? A: Both live specs drew defer from the fidelity gate. The executed and halted branches are proven, but so far only through the handfeed side door — expected, since stage 2 doesn't yet emit machine-readable QoI keys and its specs keep engaging the contract's honest limits.

Q: What does 'halted_synthesis' protect against? A: Silently running a case that doesn't implement the spec. If any parameter can't be built into the template, the builder names every offender and stops — it never guesses, never drops parameters, never invents a decomposition.

Q: Why is the 0.4168179 vs 0.4168353 pair agreement, not a bug? A: Same case, two step sizes (deltaT 0.002 vs 0.005). Different discretizations legitimately differ in the trailing digits; agreement to 4 significant figures is evidence the runner reproduces the baseline physics.

Q: What did the gate-5 EXECUTION line add? A: The human approving the iterate decision now sees what stage 4 actually did (status + per-run conclusions or the skip/halt reason) at a glance, above the raw baton JSON — display only, gating logic untouched.

Q: What's deliberately NOT handled yet? A: Stage 2 doesn't know the machine QoI keys (Step 13 opening change); stages 5-6 are still ack stubs; the fidelity check's third axis (regime-assumption certainty) remains uncovered and unclaimed.
